notes.title: Sales of Wildland in Russia
notes.notes:
Dear friends who, like us, live in Russia! In this difficult time, when it is not possible to conduct banking operations abroad, you, like us, cannot buy the games you are interested in, including our games.
To solve this problem, we hastily created the Russian online video game market, all payments in it are made in Russian rubles with the help of Russian banks. Currently, it hosts only Steam versions (keys) of our games, but we are working to attract Russian developers to our marketplace. Our online video game market is available at [url=https://eazy-market.ru/catalog/product/wildland/category_pathway-29]eazy-market.ru[/url], we invite you to make purchases on the Russian site and support Russian developers. 
If you yourself are developers or there are such people in your social circle, tell them about our platform. We invite all Russian developers to host games, games are published for FREE, we only charge a small commission on sales, all conditions are published in the appropriate section on the website [url=https://eazy-market.ru/terms-of-cooperation]eazy- market.ru[/url]
We are waiting for you in our online market!

notes.title: Long-awaited update
notes.notes:
We, finally, after a long time, found an opportunity to complete the update, which we were preparing last year, but due to all the events that happened in the world, we delayed its release. So, meet: 
[list]
[*] [b]Location system:[/b] now, under the compass, your current location is indicated, and with an active task, there is also the location on which the current goal of the task is located. As we said before, we found this method to be optimal in order to preserve the atmosphere of the game and make orientation on the terrain more convenient. In addition, this is a great incentive to explore the territory of the Last Commune, and find a lot of useful things before taking on tasks.
[*] Ability to [b]switch language[/b] in the game settings. Since the translation quality is not the same in all languages, you may find it more convenient to play in a language other than the language of your operating system. Now you can choose the language that is most convenient for you, the game interface will be translated as soon as you apply the new settings.
[*] [b]Fog density settings[/b]. There are those who like the dense fog in our game, and there are those who are uncomfortable with it. Now you can adjust the fog for yourself, or turn it off completely in the game settings.
[/list]
And, according to tradition, we thank the active members of the game community, without your help and support, this update could drag on for an even longer period. Follow our news, it will be even more interesting further.

notes.title: Corrections and additions
French localization
notes.notes:
Added support for the French language in the game.
In addition, corrections and improvements to the control settings system were made:
[list]
[*]Fixed dual key assignment in control settings;
[*]When applying or canceling settings, the settings window now closes;
[*]Added the ability to turn off gamepads connected to computers in the game.
[/list]
We thank the active members of the community for organizing the feedback.

notes.title: German localization
notes.notes: The game added support for the German language. As before, everyone with the main language of the operating system German will have the opportunity to play Wildland in their native language.

notes.title: Gamepad Support
notes.notes:
We added gamepad support to the game. You can connect any controller supported by Windows to the game, while in the game you can use any axis and button. For modern gamepads with XInput support, feedback also works.
The setting of answer keys has also been added and some changes have been made to the management of inventory, store and other windows of the interface.
In addition, a bug was fixed with the display of traditional Chinese when the text was replaced by simplified Chinese.

notes.title: Chinese localizations
notes.notes:
Support for both traditional and simplified Chinese languages has been added to the game.
Our next update will be related to support for gaming input devices.

notes.title: Weather improvements
notes.notes:
We made changes to the weather generation parameters:
[list]
[*] increased chance of sunny weather;
[*] the duration of one weather cycle is reduced until the next weather regeneration;
[*] fixed a bug with freezing weather.
[/list]
Thanks to the active community for providing feedback.

notes.title: Small improvements
notes.notes: In the settings section, a setting for viewing sensitivity of a free camera called "Look sensitivity" has been added. Also, the player’s selected camera mode is now saved when you exit the game and becomes active the next time you start the game. In addition, minor errors of the main and game menus were fixed.

notes.title: Changes in settings system
notes.notes:
We have completely redesigned the settings system. From now on, all parameters of the game are configured in the game itself in the "Settings" menu, in addition, finally, the volume settings for music and game sounds are added.
Launcher as unnecessary disabled, now the game starts immediately.

notes.title: Spanish localization and small improvements
notes.notes:
Wildland is now available in Spanish.
In addition, we corrected the minor roughness associated with the dialogues and the use of services - the car will no longer leave the dialogue if we begin to interact at full throttle.
And also in the training in the boxes and barrels are now useful for the first time things.

notes.title: Small interface improvements
notes.notes:
At the request of the community, a percentage of the mass to the load of the car’s carrying capacity has been added to the window for receiving assignments.
The time taken to complete tasks in which it is necessary to visit more than one collection point or delivery point is increased.
Increased scrolling sensitivity in inventory, shop, job retrieval window and task log.
When you select items in the inventory, the store, the window for receiving tasks and the task log using the keyboard, scrolling windows now works.
We thank active members of the community for providing feedback.

notes.title: Training in the game
notes.notes: We have added to the game a little training, available at the start of the new game. Training tells about the basics of control in the game and offers to consolidate the acquired skills.

notes.title: Some improvements
notes.notes:
The free camera is now made by the main camera, the way to switch to the classic fixed camera remains the same.
Also added the ability to adjust the volume of music in the game with the keys "+" and "-". Like any other buttons, you can reassign them to the game launcher.
In addition, illumination in foggy weather is now slightly inferior to illumination in clear weather.
Fixed the position of pop-up labels when collecting resources in the free camera mode.
In the community group appeared a brief guide to the game in Russian and English.
We thank active members of the community for providing feedback.

notes.title: New localization and bug fixes
notes.notes: Thanks to the support of the community in the game appeared Japanese! Thanks to all active community users involved in this event! In addition, we have corrected the mistakes of the free camera - now it will not move when you explore the depths of the inventory or perform any operations that require the participation of the mouse.

notes.title: First update
notes.notes:
At the request of the community, we connected a free camera in the game. By default, the "c" key is responsible for switching the camera.
We also slightly reduced the rate of decrease of the characteristics responsible for food, water and sleep.
And also corrected the order of display tips at the bottom of the screen.

notes.title: Wildland release
notes.notes: To celebrate the launch of  Wildland we give you a [b]15%[/b] discount on the purchase within a week!​
